label: preparing
what: The innkeeper and baker appear to be coordinating bread and a local baking/hospitality gathering in the great hall at eighteen. I have been told about the presentation, but not its detailed preparations or whether another purpose lies behind it. Bread transport supports preparation; reports placing the neighbour with the baker are weak evidence, not enough to establish knowing involvement. The secretary knowingly helps schedule the disclosed presentation, with no evidence of knowledge of a hidden plan.
